description: Use when the person says a Suumer listing is wrong (the time changed, it was cancelled or moved, the place is wrong, it is not open to the public) and wants Suumer told, or agrees when you offer. Sends one report to Suumer's review queue holding only the listing and which part is wrong, picked from a fixed list: no note, name, email or account is sent or kept. A person at Suumer checks the listing against its source; nothing on the listing changes by itself. Take the listing from the suumerPage of a find_events result. The same report sent twice in a day counts once.

listing.description: The listing's Suumer page (https://suumer.com/e/...) or its id.

problem.description: Which part is wrong: wrong_facts = the name, time, or other facts are wrong; cancelled_or_moved = it was cancelled or moved; wrong_place = the place or address is wrong; not_a_public_event = it is not a public event; other = something else is wrong.

name: report_listing_problem
title: Tell Suumer a listing is wrong
